wedding.description: Establish core foundation and secure major high-demand suppliers.
tasks: Finalize guest list estimate and target budget
Book ceremony and reception venue
Hire wedding planner and lead photographer/videographer
Draft theme color palette and design vision

wedding.description: Lock down experiential elements and guest logistics.
tasks: Secure caterer, bar package, and order wedding cake
Hire DJ or live band and sound engineer
Select wedding attire and schedule first fitting
Send out Save-the-Date cards and launch event website

wedding.description: Refine details, send invitations, and book rentals.
tasks: Mail formal invitations with RSVP deadline
Confirm floral arrangements, arch, and lighting rentals
Purchase wedding bands and book hair/makeup trials
Plan rehearsal dinner and reserve hotel room blocks

wedding.description: Consolidate headcounts and confirm day-of schedule.
tasks: Collect final RSVPs and submit headcount to caterer
Finalize day-of minute-by-minute timeline with vendors
Complete seating chart and print place cards/menus
Conduct final dress and suit fittings

wedding.description: Final confirmations and emergency pack preparation.
tasks: Confirm arrival windows and load-in logistics with venue
Distribute final shot list to photographer
Assemble wedding day emergency kit and pack bridal items
Pick up marriage license

wedding.description: Execute rehearsal and celebrate without stress.
tasks: Attend ceremony rehearsal and rehearsal dinner
Distribute vendor tips and final payment envelopes
Hand off decor boxes and coordinator responsibilities
Celebrate your unforgettable day!

birthday.description: Date, venue, and guest list lock-in.
tasks: Select date, time, and reserve venue or party space
Determine party theme, color scheme, and guest headcount
Send digital or printed invitations with RSVP deadline
Book key entertainment (DJ, performer, or entertainer)
Order custom birthday cake and confirm food/drink menu
Purchase party favors, games, prizes, and themed tableware
Hire event photographer or reserve photo booth rental
Create party music playlist or coordinate with DJ
Confirm final guest count with caterer/venue
Pick up party favors, non-perishable decorations, and signage
Test audio/video equipment and playlist playback
Confirm arrival schedule with entertainers/performers
Pick up birthday cake, ice, and fresh floral/balloon decor
Set up welcome table, games, and photo corner
Greet guests, serve refreshments, and cut the cake!
Capture group photos and enjoy the festivities

community.description: Permits, community partners, and site permissions.
tasks: Secure municipal permits (parks, noise, road closures, health)
Form volunteer committees (logistics, safety, hospitality)
Confirm site booking and reserve staging/AV equipment
Launch sponsorship and community outreach campaigns

community.description: Vendors, volunteer recruitment, and promotional blitz.
tasks: Book food trucks, community catering, and waste management
Recruit community volunteers and assign team leads
Print directional banners, schedules, and distribute flyers
Review public liability insurance and safety evacuation protocols
Hold all-hands volunteer orientation and assign shift badges
Confirm portable restrooms, handwash stations, and trash bins
Publish schedule and map to community bulletin and social media
Coordinate electrical drops and generator rentals with AV team

community.description: Setup, safety checks, operations, and teardown.
tasks: Mark vendor booth boundaries and erect canopies/stage
Conduct morning sound check and safety walk-through
Open information booth, first-aid station, and water stations
Execute community program, announce thank-yous, and oversee teardown
